name: calcom_cancel_booking
description: Cancel a booking by its `uid`. Provide a `cancellationReason`. Cancelling removes the event from the connected calendar (e.g. Google Calendar) and notifies attendees. This cannot be undone (re-book instead).

uid.description: The booking's unique id (uid) to cancel.

cancellationReason.description: Why the booking is being cancelled (shown to attendees).
